scripts.db:local:plan: npx wrangler d1 export myblog-web --local --no-data --output /tmp/myblog-web-local-current.sql && sqlite3def /tmp/myblog-web-local-current.sql -f schema.sql --dry-run
scripts.db:local:apply: npx wrangler d1 export myblog-web --local --no-data --output /tmp/myblog-web-local-current.sql && sqlite3def /tmp/myblog-web-local-current.sql -f schema.sql --dry-run | grep -vE '^(-- dry run --|BEGIN;|COMMIT;)$' > /tmp/myblog-web-local-migrate.sql && if [ -s /tmp/myblog-web-local-migrate.sql ]; then cf d1 raw REPLACE_WITH_PRODUCTION_DATABASE_ID --local --sql "$(cat /tmp/myblog-web-local-migrate.sql)"; else echo 'schema already matches'; fi
